SELECT request.attendance_id AS attendanceId,
CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE request.request_flag = 1 ) > 0 THEN 1
WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE request.request_flag = 2 ) > 0 THEN 2
ELSE 0 END AS requestFlag
FROM tb_trn_attendance_request request
INNER JOIN tb_trn_attendance attendance
ON request.attendance_id = attendance.attendance_id
WHERE attendance.user_id = #{employeeId}
AND attendance.working_day BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY request.attendance_id
